title: 2 injured, 10 arrested in five-hour gunfight in Maguindanao del Sur during parliament vote
summary: A five-hour gunfight near a voting precinct in Shariff Saydona Mustapha, Maguindanao del Sur injured two people and damaged some buildings, leading to the arrest of ten people, police said Tuesday.
